segments.text: Good morning everyone, this is the third quarter business review for Northwind India.
Let's start with the numbers. Revenue for the third quarter came in at 8 crore rupees, slightly above plan.
Customer churn was 4.2 percent this quarter, down from 5.1 percent in the second quarter.
Our biggest growth came from the enterprise segment, which now has 140 paying customers.
Marketing spent most of its budget on the Delhi and Mumbai trade shows.
Now, pricing. The enterprise plan has not changed in two years and our costs are up.
After a long discussion we agreed to increase the enterprise plan price by 15 percent from January.
The starter plan price stays the same, we don't want to lose small customers.
Arjun, can you prepare the revised pricing sheet? Arjun said he will have it ready by Friday.
Next topic is the hiring plan for next year.
We will hire 12 engineers in Bengaluru, mostly for the mobile and data teams, by the end of March.
Meera will share the detailed hiring budget next week.
We also talked about whether to open a small office in Singapore, but no decision was made on that.
Let's talk about targets. Given the third quarter result, we are raising the fourth quarter revenue target to 10 crore rupees.
Everyone agreed the 10 crore target is ambitious but achievable if the enterprise pipeline converts.
The marketing budget for the fourth quarter will be 1.5 crore rupees.
Open items. We still do not know whether the Pune office lease will be renewed in December.
Someone needs to follow up with the logistics vendor about the delayed hardware shipments.
Also, nobody has confirmed who owns the customer support hiring yet.
That's everything for today. Thanks everyone, see you at the next review.
